answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 44396 Country: India Title: Can we pray qaza of more than one missed Farz Salah at a time? Please, reply. Question: Can we pray qaza of more than one missed Farz Salah at a time? Please, reply. Answer ID: 44396 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 425/398/N=1434) Yes, you can pray qaza of more than one missed Farz Salah at a time. It is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
